description: Resonance Studio — a developer environment for the Resonance inference network: your nodes, the network, a local testnet, an AI coding agent (Vibecode), and the SDK.

title: Ḍād (ضاد)

title: Tulpar — Figma & screenshots to verified components
description: Turn a Figma frame or a screenshot into a component built with your design system — React, Vue, Angular or Web Components — then build, render and check it against the design before you see it.

title: Histrova — Git Graph, History & Undo
description: Edit your Git history without fear. A fast Git graph with one-click history editing, undo for everything, and a side-by-side conflict solver.

title: Drawper
description: A fast whiteboard canvas inside VS Code with system architecture and database schema panels that generate code (SQL, Prisma, Drizzle, TypeScript, docker-compose). Files use the .dpr extension.

title: Virga: Apex Scratch & Quick Fixes
description: Write some Apex or SOQL, press Ctrl+S to run it, then close the tab and it's gone. Completion for local types, quick fixes and Apex snippets. Works with Salesforce CLI and the Salesforce Extension Pack.
